item.description:
### Added - Automatic updates through Sparkle: the app checks hourly, downloads a new release in the background and installs it after you approve, instead of sending you to a download page. Updates carry an EdDSA signature checked against a key baked into the app, so a GitHub release alone cannot push code - Update checks now run from launch, including menu bar sessions that never open a window
### Changed - The homegrown GitHub Releases check is replaced by Sparkle's feed (`appcast.xml`). Users on 1.6.0 or older still have to download the next release by hand — automatic updates only work from this version forward
